_comment: Launch points. Positions are given here as lat/lon/elevation for authoring; Stage 0's ExitRegistry converts to world metres at load. Stage 1 snaps these to the DEM; Stage 4 refines by flying. Fictional placements on real geography; see docs/design/exits.md.

exits.name: The Table
exits.subtitle: Western edge
exits.blurb: The classic. Step off the top of the Table and chase the sun down to Camps Bay.

exits.name: Platteklip
exits.subtitle: North face
exits.blurb: Down the front of the mountain with the whole city in your lap. Pick your field early.

exits.name: Lion's Head
exits.subtitle: Summit
exits.blurb: Low, fast and short. There is not much mountain, so use all of it.
